NOTE
**Still not ready: the design block is cleared, but the feedback hasn't been addressed**

New: The author says Daniel K confirmed this extends the #24200 filters, so the design hold is lifted, and they asked for "maintainer review". There is no new push since the feedback. Missing: the description still has an empty "Fixes:" line and a malformed "Fixes #<36878>", and the history still includes two "ci:" retry commits that should be removed.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't add "maintainer review"; no reviewer needed yet. @karlstolley, who gave the feedback, can follow up when the PR is cleaned up.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for checking the design question with Daniel. Before we can review, please fix the PR description (a proper "Fixes: #36878" line, per the [guide on submitting a pull request](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html)) and clean up the commits by dropping the two "ci:" retry commits, per the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html).
```
